name: Big-five ranked-environment candidate validation v1
purpose: Untouched validation of the complete environment-first workflow on a third season.

environment_ranking.qualifying_rank: Top five ranked comparable environments within each Saturday/Sunday weekend.
environment_ranking.tier_C: Rank and save, but do not generate selections.
environment_ranking.excluded: Do not rank teams lacking at least five comparable matches or two venue-history matches.

candidate_A: Confirmed home starter; five previous same-player/same-team starts within 180 days; top two eligible home shooters by average shots; prior average minutes >=70; at least four of five prior starts with 2+ shots.
candidate_B: Candidate A plus prior five-start average shots >=3 and average minutes >=80.
outcome: Player records at least two total shots in the target match.
decision_policy: No changes to weekends, weights, rank cutoff, confidence gate, histories, player filters, odds, exclusions or ordering after acquisition.
limits: This is retrospective historical validation using actual starting lineups as if known at lineup time.
The ranking design was developed using the two later seasons, but the target 2024/25 outcomes have not been used to tune it in this project.
Fixed odds are hypothetical and not historical market prices.
Tier C fixtures remain research rankings only.
